title: Constant subsheaf quotient gluing
statement: Let X be a topological space, K and C abelian sheaves, and let a monomorphism K -> C identify C with the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Fix a finite family of opens A_i, natural labels 0 < c_i <= b+1, and sections s_i in K(A_i) mapping to the constant c_i in C(A_i). Let Q be any abelian sheaf and pi:K -> Q any morphism. Put U=union_i A_i and V=union_{c_i <= b} A_i. Suppose all stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] of Q on V are zero. Then there exists q:j_{U!}Z -> Q [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero] such that on every A_i with c_i=b+1 its canonical unit section maps to pi(s_i). No generating presentation of K or cokernel description of Q is assumed.

proof.text: Let V be the union of the lower-labelled opens. For every W contained in V, any two sections of Q(W) have equal germs, since all stalks there are zero. Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext therefore makes Q(W) subsingleton. The bound c_i <= b+1 implies every index not top-labelled has A_i contained in V.

On each A_i choose pi(s_i) when c_i=b+1 and zero otherwise. On intersections of two top-labelled opens, naturality of the constant-sheaf unit and hvalue give equal images under iota followed by isoC. This composite is mono, its components are injective, and hence the sections in K agree. Naturality of pi gives equality in Q. If either index is lower-labelled the intersection lies in V and step 1 gives compatibility. Apply Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing once to this family to obtain t in Q(union A_i), with the prescribed values. Empty covers and absent top layers are included.

Construct the morphism from the constant integer presheaf on U to Q restricted to U by sending m to m times the restriction of t to the image open in X. Restriction laws prove naturality. Factor through sheafification using sheafifyLift, apply abelianOpenExtensionByZero to this morphism, and compose with abelianOpenCounit. Import all Sheaf.Topology.AbelianSheafLocalIntegerGenerator and apply its existing private TopCat.extensionSection_naturality and TopCat.extensionSection_counit identities, rather than proving them again. Together with toSheafify_sheafifyLift these identify the image of the canonical integer-one section on every V contained in U with the restriction of t. Apply this for V=A_i and use the gluing equation from step 2.

proof_origin.place: Final filtration paragraph. V3 realizes the gluing in one cover and constructs the generator morphism by sheafification and the explicit extension counit. Repair of return at head 989c5ce08: reuse the existing private extension-section identities from Sheaf.Topology.AbelianSheafLocalIntegerGenerator through a proof-only import all; neither identity is restated or reproved.
